Jim B
6 contributions
0
1984 is a must visit!
Aug 2026 • Family
Stopped in on a Monday night, 9:30pm, simply on a whim as I typically steer clear of tourist streets. Glad I broke that rule! Street front was as busy as it gets, yet we (2] were seated immediately. Service was prompt and during our visit we had the opportunity, and pleasure, to chat with many of the employees. Now to the food: Beautifully presented, even for simple dishes such as fried rice. The flavor in everything popped! On to the drinks: Took a flight of their signature drinks and received more than expected. The mixologist, Thao, invites you to the bar to watch each being made, which was art in itself. The drinks produced were tip notch, local sourced or in house made ingredients, all producing fresh flavors and earthly notes.
